behavior: Prepare the preserved v3.0 core with required shared fixes and release engineering, keeping Next enhancements outside the candidate.
scope: Integration of the 2026-11-21 candidate onto checkpoint 6c72871c, the local release route, the merge of main at 98ee94b6 and review fixes. Not release qualification.
post_gate_changes: gate_tree_sha256 is the SHA-256 of `git ls-tree -r` at the gated commit. After the gate, 0276dbd9 changed only docs/developer/RELEASING.md and passed the harness-planned lanes below; then this file changed.
decisions: User: rebase the candidate additions onto remote checkpoint 6c72871c, keeping its update and Region trust enrollment.
User, 2026-11-25: no GitHub-hosted runners for any release work; build and qualify macOS, Windows and Linux on the local Mac and the two existing VMs.
User: final Stability, Performance and Security phases certify the exact draft binaries that get published.
User: only a recovery-mode restore may create a database key while an unreadable primary exists; every other existing-data path fails closed.
Immutable releases stay off until the user decides the trade-off with automatic re-draft containment.
changes: Kept checkpoint trust enrollment, update-candidate signing and metadata, and the R1 plan; the exact-draft pipeline replaces its release-snapshot, release-phases, phase-assets and public-assets client modules.
Release body bound to notes generated from the tag at draft verification, confirmation and publish, compared after line-ending and trailing-whitespace normalization.

Phase records ported from the checkpoint rules: exact release-platform coverage, exit-code-0 commands with hash-bound proofs captured inside the phase window, and owner decisions bounded by phase order.

Owner/name repository validation for every --repo reader, refusal of credentialed paths that URL parsing rewrites, macOS verifier asset identity binding, and redirect hop, userinfo, port and fragment tests.
Widened the pack-task approval expiry test window to 5 s to remove a load flake.

Local release route: a `local` platform selection whose assets need no hosted attestation, accepted only when the operator names `--selection local`; Security-record local origins required per locally built platform and checked against the draft at the publish gate.

Draft asset URLs bound to their asset ids with duplicate ids rejected; a dangling `--repo` rejected; the update signer runs through symlinked paths; the publisher refuses to start without the declared selection.
Public verification workflow is manual-only with a selection input; the security sensor row that required its publication trigger was removed to match the no-hosted-runner ruling.
Merged main at 98ee94b6 (dependency cooldown, locked cargo gates, .npmrc) with v3 header comments on its changed files.
